purpose: Reserve a later event-by-event correction for Allied ground-combat deaths/casualties caused by the newly closed Japanese non-software land-hardware layer, without reopening every past battle now.

trigger.when: At the next consolidated Allied death tally / casualty reconciliation that covers realized 1941-1944 Branch ground combat.
trigger.not_now: No numerical retroactive delta is booked in v046. Existing event outcomes and casualty ledgers remain the operative working numbers until the trigger is executed.

scope.include: Only realized CURRENT or WORKING-not-promoted ground engagements on the active Branch path through 1944-02-06 18:00 for which Japanese land-combat hardware/process could have affected fire, protection, communications, engineering or ammunition reliability.
exclude: ship sinkings and naval personnel losses except where a ground-combat ledger explicitly combines them
purely hypothetical/future or superseded legacy battles
losses already adjudicated with the v046 land-hardware layer
scope.discovery_rule: At ledger-build time scan the active frontier/current event family, not 99_LEGACY_UNTOUCHED and not stale future handouts. Candidate examples include GALVANIC Tarawa/Makin ground losses, Bengal/Arakan ground events, other active-branch Japanese-vs-Allied ground actions, and 6-Feb Kwajalein/Roi-Namur first-day losses; inclusion requires an active-path dated ledger.

event_stage_gates: Was the Japanese weapon/position/equipment physically present and not already destroyed/suppressed?
Was the target lane preregistered or observed with functioning wire/radio/visual control?
Did ammunition/fuzes survive storage and issue?
Did preparation time/material permit protected positions or obstacles?
Was the fight static/prepared, mobile/jungle, urban, amphibious, pursuit, or collapse/retreat?
Were Allied combined-arms suppression, armor, engineers, naval gunfire or artillery strong enough to erase the technical advantage before effective fire?
method.death_vs_total_casualties: Primary accounting target is Allied KIA/deaths for the consolidated death tally. If an old event provides only total killed+wounded or a broad casualty band, do not fabricate a KIA split; first reconstruct or bound the fatality share from event-local evidence.
method.outcome_guard: Default to casualty-accounting correction only. Do not retroactively change geography, capture dates, strategic decisions or order of battle unless the event-local hardware re-audit demonstrates that the prior operational outcome becomes internally inconsistent.
double_count_guards: Do not add hardware uptime as a second soft-C2 bonus when command succession/preregistered fire was already modeled.
Do not add landing-package availability gains again as weapon lethality after equipment is ashore/in position.
Do not convert artillery prepared-fire technical bands into a theater-wide hit-rate or casualty scalar.
Do not count fortification survivability twice if the old event already explicitly credited dispersed magazines/revetments.

expected_direction_not_amount.prepared_amphibious_defense: Usually modest upward Allied ground-death pressure if surviving registered weapons/crews were previously treated at historical technical reliability; can be near zero under overwhelming pre-landing suppression.
expected_direction_not_amount.burma_bengal_sustained_ground_fighting: Potentially more material than sealed-atoll cases because artillery/mortar/engineer/comms hardware can persist for days or weeks; requires separate event audit.
expected_direction_not_amount.mobile_or_collapsing_battles: Often small or ambiguous because observation, supply and prepared positions are absent.
expected_direction_not_amount.net_total: UNKNOWN until the consolidated ledger is rebuilt; v046 deliberately books no aggregate number.

current_event_hold.Kwajalein_Roi_Namur_6Feb: Keep v043 first-day US ground/landing figure 430-620 killed+wounded plus separate LST-224 personnel loss as the current working figure. Mark it provisional for the later consolidated ledger; do not silently replace it in v046.
current_event_hold.GALVANIC: Keep closed GALVANIC outcome/casualty ledgers unchanged until the consolidated death-tally trigger. The land-hardware omission is a reserved accounting delta, not permission to reroll carrier/air/naval events.
